title: Free Weekend: Lie Party — a party game for friends, played on one TV
author: bursinru
selftext:
I’ve made **Lie Party**, a party game for groups of friends.

You can play together in front of one TV or completely online. The host launches the game on a large screen, while everyone else joins through a browser on their phones.

https://preview.redd.it/hwd0i2bugmgh1.png?width=2468&format=png&auto=webp&s=27de1d552f168349056a3c271409cc0cb9727948

👥 **3–8 players**  
📱 **Join from any phone or browser**  
🎥 **Streamer Mode included**  
⏱ **Each match takes around 15–20 minutes**

The game was created with the help of AI tools — from the visual style and characters to some of the game ideas and assets.

**The game was made using Fable 5 and ChatGPT.**

# Play for free this weekend

From **July 31 to August 3**, you can try the game for free and play with your friends.

The beta demo currently includes four game modes:

# ✏️ Bad Artist

Everyone receives a secret word except one player — the Faker.

Players take turns adding a single line to a shared drawing without making the secret word too obvious. The Faker must pretend they know what everyone is drawing, while the others try to identify them.

https://preview.redd.it/t8hvnafwgmgh1.png?width=2468&format=png&auto=webp&s=08ea9cef2fe35294a89f6db39104b9e8529d12c9

# 🕵️ The Spy

Everyone knows the secret location except one player — the Spy.

Players answer questions and try to figure out who has no idea where they are. Meanwhile, the Spy must avoid being discovered and try to guess the location.

https://preview.redd.it/xau0dutxgmgh1.png?width=2468&format=png&auto=webp&s=d23127fa4f549f261fe97d3b3c02af4bf29c3238

# 📝 Blind Writer

Players create a story together, one sentence at a time.

Almost everyone can see the previous sentence, but one player has to continue the story without seeing it. At the end, everyone tries to identify who was writing blind.

https://preview.redd.it/xttki9f3hmgh1.png?width=2468&format=png&auto=webp&s=b40ed67d73ecc896d8c1aa08d70d0e9a99224fce

# ❓ Strange Answers

A strange answer appears on the screen, and players must invent questions that could have led to it.

Everyone then votes and tries to identify the original question.

https://preview.redd.it/1mb6rk94hmgh1.png?width=2468&format=png&auto=webp&s=ed9929b523a40924b79d7c833c2c3e9b27caba28

I’d really appreciate your feedback:

• Which mode did you enjoy the most?  
• Which one created the funniest moments?  
• Was anything confusing?  
• What felt missing?  
• What new game modes would you like to see?

Try the free beta demo:

[**https://www.lieparty.com/#/promo/reddit-en**](https://www.lieparty.com/#/promo/reddit-en)

**Lie Party — Sketch Trap**

If you enjoy it, I’d be incredibly grateful for a review.

I have a lot of unfinished game prototypes, but I’ve decided to start sharing them, gathering feedback and finding out which ideas are worth developing further.
